# Copyright and crawling policy

This policy explains how the mobility-model-zoo collects texts for text and data mining, which opt-out signals it honours, and how rights holders can ask for removal. Last updated: 2026-10-08.

## Legal basis

- Text and data mining under §44b of the German Copyright Act (UrhG, Art. 4 of Directive (EU) 2019/790). We do not rely on the research exception of §60d UrhG.
- Official works (§5 UrhG) and texts under open licences (for example CC BY 4.0) are used under their terms.
- Copies are kept only as long as needed to reproduce the frozen benchmark and the training data of a current model, and are then deleted.

## Our crawler

User agent: `mobility-model-zoo-crawler/1.0 (+https://github.com/mhabedank/mobility-model-zoo/blob/main/COPYRIGHT_POLICY.md)`.

Before we fetch a page we check, and we do not fetch when any of them says no:

- robots.txt for our user agent, for `*`, and for these AI crawler agents: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, CCBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, Amazonbot, cohere-ai, Diffbot, omgili, Timpibot. A disallow for any of them counts as an opt-out from text and data mining.
- TDM reservation (TDMRep): `/.well-known/tdmrep.json`, the `tdm-reservation` HTTP header and meta tag.
- `noai`, `noml` and `noimageai` in `X-Robots-Tag` or in the robots meta tag.
- ai.txt.
- Terms of service: terms that prohibit text and data mining in plain language count as an opt-out (owner decision D6, until the Federal Court of Justice decides on machine-readable reservations).
- We never bypass logins, paywalls or CAPTCHAs, and we do not fetch from known shadow libraries.

If robots.txt cannot be read because of a server error, we do not fetch and try later.

## What we publish

We publish models, their documentation and evaluation numbers. We do not publish the collected texts. Published files contain at most 30 consecutive words from a collected text, except attributed quotes from official works or openly licensed texts. Training data sources and their licences are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/mhabedank/mobility-model-zoo/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and in each model card.

## Removal requests

Rights holders can ask us to stop using a work or a whole website: write to contact@miskatonic-analytics.com, or open a "Rights request" issue on GitHub for requests without personal data. We answer within 14 days, delete stored copies, and add the work or website to our deny list so that it is not fetched again. A model that was already published is reviewed; withdrawing it is decided case by case.
